cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Will you give me your first turn, even if it costs you the match?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You said you were on my side. This side has a cost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lend the emotion a turn so I can see it.
